title: DECISION: Database join preserves authorization boundary for peer blobs
description: get_peer_mailbox_for_blob (kith-store/lib.rs:261-286) joins attachments → messages → contacts. Only returns blob info when sender_user_id has a contacts row (peer-sent messages). Owner-sent messages have no contacts row → returns None. Prevents owner from accidentally triggering peer fetch for their own attachments. Boundary is tested (kith-store tests:895-933).
